text: Before you pick a remedy for an "overdose", find out what they actually swallowed, how much and when, because that word alone doesn't tell you much. Then look at what their body is doing. Slow, shallow breathing (respiratory depression) is a different problem from a racing stimulant high, and both are different from serotonin toxicity, a seizure, dangerous overheating, etc., so each gets its own remedy.
reader: someone with a person who swallowed too much of something recently, deciding what to do first: what to find out, whether to give activated charcoal, whether to call poison control
